briefTitle: KEYMAKER-U01 Substudy 01A: Efficacy and Safety Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) With or Without Chemotherapy When Used With Investigational Agents in Treatment-naïve Participants With Stage IV Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (MK-3475-01A/KEYMAKER-U01A)

typedChecks.sourceText: Has histologically- or cytologically-confirmed diagnosis of Stage IV squamous or nonsquamous NSCLC
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has histologically- or cytologically-confirmed diagnosis of Stage IV squamous or nonsquamous NSCLC

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with nonsquamous NSCLC who are not eligible for an approved targeted therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Eligibility for targeted therapy involves investigator judgment and clinical assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Is able to provide archival tumor tissue sample collected either within 5 years or within the interval from completion of last treatment but before entering the screening period or newly obtained core or excisional biopsy of a tumor lesion not previously irradiated obtained within 90 days of treatment initiation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or ability to undergo biopsy or provide tissue is a subjective procedure-based criterion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Is able to complete all screening procedures within the 35-day screening window for Part A and 28-day screening window for Part B
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Ability to complete screening procedures is a logistical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a diagnosis of small cell lung cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Histology exclusion for small cell lung cancer is handled via trial scope and nonsquamous/squamous inclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy (in dosing exceeding 10 mg daily of prednisone equivalent) or any other form of immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days before the first dose of study treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Chronic systemic steroid dosing with prednisone equivalents and immunosuppressive therapy cannot be represented as a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 2 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Additional malignancy history with active treatment timeline is complex.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has an active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active autoimmune disease and systemic treatment history is a judgment-based criterion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a history of (noninfectious) pneumonitis that required steroids or has current pneumonitis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pneumonitis history requiring steroids is not a standard typed lab or staging check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has an active infection requiring systemic therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active infection requiring systemic therapy is subject to investigator discretion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has clinically significant cardiac disease, including unstable angina, acute myocardial infarction within 6 months from Day 1 of study treatment administration, or New York Heart Association Class III or IV congestive heart failure
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinically significant cardiac disease and NYHA class restrictions are clinical assessments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection. Well-controlled HIV with anti-retroviral therapy (ART) is not excluded
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV infection status with ART control nuances cannot be cleanly captured by a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a known history of Hepatitis B (HPV) or known active Hepatitis C virus infection. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positive is eligible if on HBV antiviral therapy for at least 4 weeks and HBV viral load is undetectable prior to randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hepatitis serology and viral load conditions with specific antiviral timelines are too complex for simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has had major surgery <3 weeks before the first dose of study treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Major surgery washout window is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Is expected to require any other form of antineoplastic therapy while on study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Future treatment expectations require investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a history or current evidence of a gastrointestinal (GI) condition (e.g. inflammatory bowel disease, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis) or impaired liver function or diseases that in the opinion of the investigator may significantly alter the absorption or metabolism of oral medications
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator opinion on GI and metabolic conditions is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Is getting chemotherapy and has clinically active diverticulitis, intra-abdominal abscess, GI obstruction, or peritoneal carcinomatosis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active diverticulitis and related conditions during chemotherapy are clinical judgments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has preexisting neuropathy that is moderate in intensity
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Grading of preexisting neuropathy intensity is a clinical assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received prior systemic cytotoxic chemotherapy or other targeted or biological antineoplastic therapy for metastatic disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior systemic therapies for metastatic disease overlap with prior line rules and require qualitative interpretation.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Is unable or unwilling to take folic acid or vitamin B12 supplementation, for participants who will receive pemetrexed
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or ability to take specific vitamin supplementation is a subjective patient behavior item.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a known sensitivity to any component of carboplatin, paclitaxel, pemetrexed or any of their excipients
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Drug hypersensitivity evaluations are clinical judgments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received prior radiation therapy to the lung that is >30 Gray (Gy) within 6 months of the first dose of study treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior lung radiation dose and time window combination cannot be represented with a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received a live vaccine within 30 days before the first dose of study treatment. Any licensed COVID-19 vaccine (including for Emergency Use) in a particular country is allowed as long as they are messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) vaccines, adenoviral vaccines, or inactivated vaccines. Investigational vaccines (ie, those not licensed or approved for Emergency Use) are not allowed
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Vaccine history rules with specific allowed mRNA/inactivated types and time windows are complex.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received any prior immunotherapy and was discontinued from that treatment due to a severe or worse immune-related adverse event (irAE)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Discontinuation due to severe irAEs requires clinical causality assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has had chemotherapy or biological cancer therapy within 4 weeks before the first dose of study treatment or has not recovered to Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Grade 1 or better from the AEs due to cancer therapeutics administered more than 4 weeks before the first dose of study treatment (including participants who had previous immunomodulatory therapy with residual irAEs)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout windows and CTCAE recovery requirements are non-lab toxicity rules.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Is currently participating in or has participated in a study of an investigational agent or has used an investigational device within 4 weeks before the first dose of study treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concurrent or recent investigational study participation washout is a trial administration rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Previously had a severe hypersensitivity reaction to treatment with monoclonal antibodies (including pembrolizumab) and/or any of their excipients
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Severe hypersensitivity history to monoclonal antibodies is a clinical judgment item.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has had an allogenic tissue/solid organ transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: History of allogeneic tissue or solid organ transplant is an exclusion not covered by a typed check.
